note: The newest model bundle version this app release knows about, per phone class. scripts/pack-bundle.sh reads the version from here, so a bundle and this file cannot drift. update_kind is how a phone upgrading from any older version is affected: pack-only | query-only | text-reembed | full-reembed | config. Raise version (and set update_kind) only with the release that ships a better bundle.
addons_note: Signed add-on bundles (role addon, class any; scripts/pack-bundle.sh VARIANT=speech). Their versions are their own; the app reads only 'classes' for the update notice. The vision upgrade (VARIANT=vision) is a standard-class bundle and takes the standard version.
